80257: A second-year at Mihama Academy, and the daughter of the East Beach Railway Express Group tycoon. She was the first student to enroll at Mihama Academy. She has waist-length black hair. Because of her bluntness and hard-to-please personality, she has difficulty talking to others.
80891: The protagonist of Grisaia. Ace number 9029, Yuuji is the “janitor” for the underworld. Tired of the life, he wanted to live a normal school life. Cool, philosophical, and minimalist, Yuuji is a realist…but also tsundere.
80893: First-year student at Mihama Academy, an innocent and carefree girl. For some inexplicable reasons, it’s hard to understand her personality. In general, she can be explained in one word, “fool”, but sometime her speeches and behaviors make people shed cold sweat.
80895: First-year student at Mihama Academy and the maid of Mihama Academy. Except when going to school, taking a bath, or swimming, she always wears her maid uniform. The students at Mihama told her to wear maid uniform as much as possible as a joke, but she took it seriously.
80897: Second-year student at Mihama Academy, a fake tsundere with bleached blonde twintails. She has a deep interest in tsundere characters and tries to act like one. Her silly and energetic personality makes her becomes the mood maker of the class. Her grades are bad.
80899: Third-year student at Mihama Academy, she is the big sister type who always takes care of others. Because of unknown circumstances, she skipped one school year at her previous school, so she is actually two years older than Yuuji. She is tall and has a good figure.
88371: Kazuki is Yuuji's elder sister as well as the one who taught him throughout the earlier periods of his life. Despite her delicate and diminutive body, she has brilliant intellect and excels in quick-witted judgement to the point that she has been labelled as a genius.
88521: The only daughter of prefectural governor and the principal of Mihama academy. To her, Yuuji is a benefactor of life, as he rescued her in an event in the past.
124692: mother of Yuuji and Kazuki. Weak of spirit. Despite mistrusting others' affections, was often reliant upon them. Thought to have been a sad woman.
124719: Asako was Yuuji's former master. She took charge of raising Yuuji when his parents passed away. She was both harsh and sweet, capable and incompetent and drilled many of her own values into Yuuji.
132553: She is a black ops operative who happens to be Yuuji's guardian and handler. Her former name is Julia Bardera but she changed it after moving to Japan, that’s why Yuuji calls her JB. Though she looks American, she is a mixed blood between German and Italian.
191681: An international terrorist who was an acquaintance of Yuuji's father, and took him after Yuuji killed his father. He trains Yuuji to be an assassin, and has him complete missions for him. He is the main antagonist of Grisaia no Rakuen.
192764: Only friend" of Yuuji in the terrorist training facility.
226833: Millie is an old acquaintance of Yuuji from his days at the military, and she fell in love with Yuuji when he bested her in a shooting competition, although Yuuji only sees her as obnoxious, and he even punched her in the face during their first encounter.
248740: Yumiko's father and the leader of the "Tohin Railway Group" financial clique. He is also the chief director of Mihama Academy.
248825: Makina's mother and the director of Iris Global.
248917: Chiaki's father and former president of an IT company. His hobby is hunting.
248932: The husband of Satoko Kazami and the father of Yuuji Kazami and Kazuki Kazami who had an interest in art and he was an antique dealer.
